# markdown

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/markdown"
```

Package markdown writes the reference pages: one table of arguments per documented section, cross\-linked to the example pages.

<a name="DefaultColumns"></a>DefaultColumns is the table when a Layout names none: Format appears only when some field in that table declares one.

```go
var DefaultColumns = []Column{ColName, ColType, ColFormat, ColDescription, ColRequired, ColDefault}
```

<a name="Column"></a>
## type [Column](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/markdown/columns.go#L12>)

Column is one column of the arguments table.

```go
type Column int
```

<a name="ColName"></a>

```go
const (
    ColName Column = iota
    ColType
    ColFormat
    ColDescription
    ColRequired
    ColDefault
    ColValues      // the allowed values, from oneof
```

<a name="Config"></a>
## type [Config](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/markdown/markdown.go#L49-L54>)

Config is one markdown run: where the pages go, how they are laid out, and where the example pages they link to live.

```go
type Config struct {
    Dir           string
    Layout        Layout
    ExamplesDir   string
    ExampleTitles map[string]string
}
```

<a name="FileMode"></a>
## type [FileMode](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/markdown/markdown.go#L25>)

FileMode decides how many pages an entry is split into.

```go
type FileMode int
```

<a name="FilePerEntry"></a>

```go
const (
    // FilePerEntry writes one page per entry, nested sections inlined.
    FilePerEntry FileMode = iota
    // FilePerField also gives each object-shaped direct field its own page,
    // which the entry's page links to. Scalars are never split, and the split
    // stops one level down: deeper objects stay inline in their parent's page.
    FilePerField
    // FileSingle writes one page holding every entry, one after another.
    FileSingle
)
```

<a name="FolderMode"></a>
## type [FolderMode](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/markdown/markdown.go#L15>)

FolderMode decides whether an entry's pages get a directory of their own.

```go
type FolderMode int
```

<a name="FolderFlat"></a>

```go
const (
    // FolderFlat writes every page straight into the markdown directory.
    FolderFlat FolderMode = iota
    // FolderPerEntry gives each entry a subdirectory named after its slug.
    FolderPerEntry
)
```

<a name="Layout"></a>
## type [Layout](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/markdown/markdown.go#L40-L45>)

Layout is where pages land and what the tables show. The zero value is one flat page per entry with DefaultColumns.

```go
type Layout struct {
    Folders FolderMode
    Files   FileMode
    // Columns are the table's columns, in order. nil is DefaultColumns.
    Columns []Column
}
```
